description: AST-tester probes for TypeScript/TSX — exercises grammar (const exports, generics), chunker, and ranker for idiomatic patterns. Includes regression anchor for tsx const extraction bug.

probes.query: how does the chat handle streaming delta updates and dispatch them to the artifact panel
probes.notes: NL behavior probe. Tests whether the chunker/ranker surfaces the useEffect dispatch loop in DataStreamHandler — a 'use client' component with no JSX return (returns null), which can confuse parsers that expect a visible render tree from a .tsx file.

probes.query: where does the chat auto-scroll when new messages arrive and how does it detect whether the user has scrolled away
probes.notes: NL behavior probe. Targets a custom hook defined in a .tsx file (unusual — most hooks live in .ts). The file uses MutationObserver + ResizeObserver, not JSX; tests that the indexer does not skip or mis-classify .tsx files that export zero JSX.

probes.query: how does the server decide which AI model to call and what tools to enable based on the incoming request
probes.notes: NL behavior probe. Tests routing to a Next.js Route Handler inside a parenthesised segment directory `(chat)`, which path-tokenizers may parse unexpectedly. No expectedSymbol — the relevant logic is spread across the POST handler body.

probes.query: codeArtifact definition including its onStreamPart handler and toolbar actions
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe. Regression anchor for the tsx const-extraction bug: `export const codeArtifact = new Artifact<"code", Metadata>(...)` is a generic-typed new-expression assigned to an export const in a .tsx file — precisely the pattern that was silently dropped by the broken tsx grammar.

probes.query: textArtifact streaming configuration and how text deltas accumulate into artifact content
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe. Second regression anchor: another `export const X = new Artifact<"text", Metadata>(...)` pattern in a .tsx file. Verifies the const-extraction fix generalises across all artifact client files, not just code/client.tsx.

probes.query: slashCommands array listing every available slash command with its action and description
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe. Tests extraction of `export const slashCommands: SlashCommand[] = [...]` — an explicitly typed array literal in a .tsx file that also exports a React component (SlashCommandMenu) in the same file. Exercises the chunker's ability to index both the const and the component from a single file.

probes.query: per-user message rate limits and entitlements by account type
probes.notes: Grammar edge-case probe. `export const entitlementsByUserType: Record<UserType, Entitlements> = { ... }` uses a two-argument generic type annotation on the const declaration. Tests that the chunker does not truncate the type parameter list when extracting the symbol name — a known failure mode for naive regex-based extractors.

probes.query: how the system prompt is composed from geolocation hints and whether tools are enabled for the model
probes.notes: Grammar edge-case probe. `export const systemPrompt = ({ requestHints, supportsTools }: { ... }) => { ... }` is a destructured-parameter arrow function assigned to an export const. Tests that parsers correctly resolve the symbol name despite the inline object-type annotation in the parameter list — a pattern that confuses extractors expecting `(param: Type)` vs `({ key }: ObjectType)`.
